title: Ledger home — personal finance
brief: Responsive ledger home for a personal finance app (Spanish-first users): sticky per-currency balance summary (income, expenses, current balance = Σ initial balance + income − expenses), transactions of the current month by default or a chosen date range, top bar with '+ Nuevo movimiento' (income/expense/transfer modal) and a Management menu (Accounts, Categories, Currencies, Preferences dialogs), financial design system with light/dark mode persisted as 'tfm-theme-mode'.

artboards.title: Sidebar dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar, scalable nav with hero balance cards and a dense table; the sidebar burns width on tablet and mobile (collapses to an icon rail, then a bottom bar) and the table scrolls horizontally instead of reflowing.

artboards.title: Mobile-first topbar
artboards.tradeoff: Best mobile ergonomics for the spec's stated mobile/tablet audience — thumb-reach FAB, day-grouped cards, slidable balance strip — at the cost of lower information density on wide screens (cards only become a table at ≥960px).

artboards.title: Command center
artboards.tradeoff: Power-user density and fast switching — icon rail, currency chips, month carousel, split list+detail — but the most complex to build and the steepest learning curve; detail pane must stack above the list on narrow screens.

artboards.title: Híbrido 01+02 — violeta fintech
artboards.tradeoff: Desktop con sidebar dashboard y tabla densa; mobile con carrusel, cards por día, tabbar y FAB — un solo codebase responsivo. Es la opción de mayor cobertura pero la más extensa de mantener: dos layout systems en un solo artboard.

artboards.title: Híbrido 01+02 — vista móvil (390px)
artboards.tradeoff: Mismo artboard responsivo que 04, renderizado a ancho móvil para revisar el layout <960px: carrusel de monedas, quick actions, cards por día, FAB y tabbar.
